references.name: Cold Turkey Blocker
references.pattern: Overview, Blocks, Statistics and Settings are documented as separate destinations for separate user outcomes.
references.tradeoff: Enforcement behavior and system integration require OS privileges; copying exact architecture is not warranted.

references.name: Freedom
references.pattern: Blocklists, recurring focus schedules and locked sessions communicate distinct tasks and safety constraints.
references.tradeoff: Its cross-device product scope and hosting assumptions may not fit a low-cost Windows-only application.

references.name: Opal
references.pattern: A published brand kit documents typography, black/white foundations and rare gradient emphasis instead of constant colored cards.
references.tradeoff: Opal's premium art direction, trade dress, fonts and assets are not reusable as our brand; an original identity is needed.

comparisons.gap: The supplied screenshot crowds several independent workflows into one form and leaves interaction hierarchy unclear.
comparisons.improvement: Propose a focused workspace with clear explanatory text and a primary action, progressive details, and meaningful empty states.
comparisons.not_copied: Do not duplicate the benchmark's icons, product illustration, logo, exact palette or layout pixel-for-pixel.

design_system.body_font: To be selected with readable metrics and licensing
design_system.arabic_font: To be selected after Arabic and mixed-script test
design_system.illustration_policy: Use one original 2D character illustration for empty or completed focus-state meaning; no random decorative 3D toys; respect motion and asset size.
design_system.density_rationale: Focus is one quiet hero surface; list of blocked apps, schedules, historical insights and settings live in named destinations.

design_directions.layout: Timer first, a generous whitespace region, a concise next-action card and secondary navigation.
Illustrated 2D companion with restrained progress visual and step-based setup rather than full-form home page.

review.decision_reason: Most visits should make starting a safe focus session obvious, without exposing all configuration fields on entry.
